# NashikTourism.com

> An independent, source-checked guide to Nashik, Trimbakeshwar and the Simhastha Kumbh Mela 2026-28.

NashikTourism.com is an independent publisher. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any government body, temple trust, the Nashik-Trimbakeshwar Kumbh Mela Authority or any tourism board. Every factual claim carries its own status (Verified, Reported or Not yet verified) with a named source; unconfirmed figures are labelled rather than stated as fact.

Language: English (with short Hindi and Marathi answers on the distance guide). Region: Nashik district, Maharashtra, India. Pages show a "Last updated" and "Last verified" date.

Full text of the main pages: https://nashiktourism.com/llms-full.txt

## Distances & transport

- [Nashik to Trimbakeshwar Distance (and Back): km & Time](https://nashiktourism.com/blog/trimbakeshwar-to-nashik-distance-route/): Trimbakeshwar is about 29–30 km from Nashik CBS (55–60 min) and 37–39 km from Nashik Road station. Google Maps, 22 Nov 2026. Distance table, bus, jeep, cab.
- [Nashik Road Station to Trimbakeshwar: Distance and Options](https://nashiktourism.com/transport/nashik-road-station-to-trimbakeshwar/): Nashik Road railway station is about 37–39 km (roughly 1 hr 15 min) from Trimbakeshwar by road. Google Maps, 22 Nov 2026. Cab, bus via CBS and Kumbh notes.
- [Trimbakeshwar to Panchavati and Ramkund: Distance and Options](https://nashiktourism.com/transport/trimbakeshwar-to-panchavati-ramkund/): Trimbakeshwar to Ramkund and Panchavati is about 30–31 km (roughly 1 hr) by road. Google Maps, 22 Nov 2026. Bus, jeep and cab options and Kumbh 2027 notes.
- [Transport hub: how to reach Nashik and get around](https://nashiktourism.com/transport/): How to reach Nashik by air, train, bus and road, plus Mumbai, Pune and Delhi routes, Trimbakeshwar, local transport and Kumbh transport, each fact labelled by how well it is verified.
- [How to Reach Nashik for Kumbh Mela 2027 – Train, Bus, Flight Guide](https://nashiktourism.com/blog/how-to-reach-nashik-for-kumbh-mela/): A guide to reaching Nashik for Kumbh Mela 2027 by train, bus, road or air, and what to check before you travel. - [Nashik Kumbh Mela 2027: Dates, Guide, Stay and Passes](https://nashiktourism.com/kumbh-mela-2027/): Nashik Simhastha Kumbh Mela 2027 guide: official dates, where to stay, passes, roads and safety, each marked verified, reported or unconfirmed, with sources.

Other bathing days not announced.

## Destinations

- [Places to Visit in Nashik: Top Tourist Places List (2026 Guide)](https://nashiktourism.com/discover-nashik/): Places to visit in Nashik: 14 top tourist places with type, time needed and links. Trimbakeshwar, Ramkund, Sula, Pandavleni, Igatpuri, Bhandardara.
- [Trimbakeshwar Temple, Nashik – Visitor Guide](https://nashiktourism.com/discover-nashik/trimbakeshwar/): A guide to Trimbakeshwar, the Jyotirlinga temple town in the hills west of Nashik and one of the focal points of the Nashik Kumbh Mela.
- [Panchavati & Ramkund, Nashik – Visitor Guide](https://nashiktourism.com/discover-nashik/panchavati/): A guide to Panchavati, the old riverside quarter of Nashik, and Ramkund, its best-known bathing ghat on the Godavari.
- [Ramkund Ghat Nashik – History, Visiting Tips & Kumbh Mela](https://nashiktourism.com/blog/ramkund-ghat-nashik-guide/): Guide to Ramkund Ghat in Nashik: history, visiting etiquette, how to reach it and its place in the Kumbh Mela 2027. Timings and arrangements are not verified; check locally.
- [Igatpuri – Visitor Guide](https://nashiktourism.com/discover-nashik/igatpuri/): A guide to Igatpuri, the Western Ghats hill town in Nashik district and a common monsoon weekend trip from Mumbai and Pune. Bhandardara, just beyond the district line, has its own guide.
- [Bhandardara: Arthur Lake, Randha Falls, Fireflies and How to Reach](https://nashiktourism.com/discover-nashik/bhandardara/): Bhandardara guide: Arthur Lake, Randha and Umbrella Falls, firefly season, Igatpuri vs Bhandardara, how to reach from Nashik, Mumbai and Pune, monsoon safety.
- [Sula Vineyards, Nashik – Visitor Guide](https://nashiktourism.com/discover-nashik/sula-vineyards/): A guide to visiting Sula Vineyards in the hills outside Nashik — what a vineyard visit involves and how it fits into a Nashik trip.
- [Pandavleni Caves, Nashik – Visitor Guide](https://nashiktourism.com/discover-nashik/pandavleni-caves/): A guide to the Pandavleni Caves, the group of rock-cut chambers in the hillside south of Nashik city.
